title: Investigate ITSI KPIs, Dependencies, and Service Health
objectives: Investigate ITSI KPIs, Dependencies, and Service Health
Verify real recorded events, retained failures and current operational evidence.

tasks.instruction: Open Interview workbench → Recorded service health. The initial model is a teaching JSON format, not a native ITSI service export. It derives actual query KPIs from service_logs. Inspect the two checkout failures, the overly loose critical threshold and the absent authentication dependency.

For checkout keep the actual error search and field error_rate, weight=11 (native minimum-health indicator importance), warning=5; set critical=20 and dependencies=["authentication"]. Preserve the authentication latency KPI. Stage, activate and evaluate: checkout should be critical with score=0 while its dependency is healthy. Retain this actual failure evaluation.

Advance the paused clock by two minutes so old errors leave the -1m window; a new evaluation with no fresh records must show unknown. On virtual idx01 append /opt/staging/v7-healthy-service-records.log to /var/log/practice/service-health.log, then advance an input tick. Evaluate again and verify checkout score=100 from real fresh records and a healthy authentication dependency. Independently search index=service_logs service=checkout earliest=-1m | stats avg(status) as status and inspect the job. The bounded model uses native weighted KPI contributions and importance-11 critical behavior, with three contribution levels and all KPIs selected from each listed dependency. It is separate from a native service export and full entity/threshold/dependency controls.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.

references.purpose: Native weighted health contributions, importance 0–11 and minimum-health critical indicators

checks.label: Actual KPI failure corrected with active dependencies and new healthy source records
checks.search: index=service_logs service=checkout | eval error=if(status>=500,100,0) | stats avg(error) as error_rate

checks.label: Independent actual-record result
checks.search: index=service_logs service=checkout earliest=-1m | stats avg(status) as status

feedback.success: Verified operational state and retained evidence meet the lesson outcomes.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect actual source, activation, receipts and independent evidence.
